verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws. The 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow was moved below the body copy and enlarged with wide tracking, so it competes with the headline and breaks the reading order. The logo is right-aligned while all the text is left-aligned. The headline, body and eyebrow are crammed together with almost no spacing between them. The dark card fills nearly the whole canvas and runs off the bottom, so the city skyline, a key image in the original, is reduced to thin slivers at the edges. B's slightly larger headphones fill the middle better and leave less dead space above the CTA than A's smaller ones, but the difference is marginal.
